title: Beauty Pageant Contestant Alleges Casting Couch Incident
summary: Akanksha Choudhary, a contestant on Lock Upp 2, has alleged that she was subjected to a casting couch incident in the beauty pageant industry. The incident occurred during her modelling days and involved an unnamed person offering her money. Choudhary claimed that she was offered Rs 1-2 lakh (approximately $13,000-$26,000 USD) for sexual favours. The incident is being investigated by the police.
summary_points: Akanksha Choudhary alleged a casting couch incident occurred during her modelling days
The incident involved an unnamed person offering money in exchange for sexual favours
Choudhary claimed to have been offered Rs 1-2 lakh (approximately $13,000-$26,000 USD)
The police are investigating the incident
